extensionDescription.message: Filter mydealz.de postings by keywords in titles. Hide unwanted deals and show the number of hidden postings.

popupSubtitleWithTotal.message: Hide postings by keywords • Total hidden: $COUNT$

filterTermsPlaceholder.message:
Enter keywords separated by commas
Example: iPhone, Apple, Samsung

filterTermsHintPopup.message: Click in this field to unlock editing. Enter keywords separated by commas. Postings with these terms in the title will be hidden (unless they also contain an exception term).

filterTermsHintOptions.message: Click in this field to unlock editing. Deals containing these terms in the title will be hidden unless they also match an exception term.

exceptionTermsPlaceholder.message:
Enter exception keywords separated by commas
Example: Android, Windows

exceptionTermsHintPopup.message: Click in this field to unlock editing. Enter keywords separated by commas. Postings containing these terms will NOT be hidden, even if they also contain filter terms. Example: If you filter 'Apple' but add 'Android' as an exception, a post titled 'Apple and Android phone deals' won't be hidden.

exceptionTermsHintOptions.message: Click in this field to unlock editing. Deals containing these terms remain visible even if they contain a filter term.

importHintPopup.message: Import opens the Options page. There, click Import again.

preferencesCopy.message: Optional quality-of-life features for browsing mydealz.de.

shortcutHintPopup.message: Open your browser's extension shortcuts page to change shortcuts.

shortcutHintOptions.message: Open your browser's extension shortcuts page to change shortcuts.

shortcutManualHint.message: Open your browser's extension shortcuts page to change shortcuts.

autoSortDescPopup.message: Set comment sorting to "am hilfreichsten" on deal pages.

autoSortDescOptions.message: Only on deal detail pages. Disabled by default.

greyOutDescPopup.message: Fade repeated deals after they leave the viewport or after you leave the deal page.

greyOutDescOptions.message: Keeps deals clickable, but fades repeats only after you scroll past them or leave the deal page.

greyOutOpacityDescPopup.message: Set how faded seen deals should look.

greyOutOpacityDescOptions.message: Set how faded seen deals should look (0% = invisible, 100% = normal).

seenCacheHint.message: Clears the history of deals you've already scrolled past, so they won't be greyed out anymore.

resetSeenDealsConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to clear your 'seen deals' history? All deals will look 'new' again.

categoriesCopy.message: Organize filter terms into categories, toggle them on or off, and inspect their counts in Statistics.

howToUseStep3.message: Visit mydealz.de — postings with those keywords will be hidden
